nemotron-3.5-super-vl.name: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B

nemotron-3.5-super-vl.good_for: The smartest Nemotron one 128 GB Spark runs: agents, coding, documents and images

note: Sizes are the files each launch mounts (GB, 1e9 bytes), drafters included: Bolt GGUF 23.749 + LiLiCorr GGUF 1.000; Super VL NVFP4 GGUF 76.92 + mmproj Q8_0 0.97 + LiLiCorr 1.35; Bolt safetensors 24.12 (+0.96 LiLiCorr in the TensorFold launch).
